title: Visa Intelligent Commerce link: token, passkey and instruction behind a TAP checkout
summary: What happens in VIC around a TAP purchase, using only the endpoint paths in Visa's own API client. The agent enrolls a card, which provisions an agent-specific token, with step-up and passkey setup where required; the consumer authenticates a purchase instruction, which the agent then creates in VIC with that result; the agent retrieves credentials, presents them to the merchant in a TAP checkout, and reports the outcome as a confirmation.
specVersion: TAP spec, unversioned (read 2026-10-11, rechecked 2026-10-19); VIC API client in visa/ai (2026-09-30)

steps.label: Ask the agent to add a card
steps.detail: The consumer links a Visa card to the agent.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/cards
steps.detail: The agent enrolls the card in VIC. VIC provisions an agent-specific token through the Visa Token Service, then runs issuer step-up where required and Visa Payment Passkey setup with device binding.

failures.outcome: The card is not enabled for the agent unless Visa approved the use case without a passkey

steps.label: Authenticate the instruction with a passkey
steps.detail: The agent asks the consumer to authenticate the purchase instruction with a Visa Payment Passkey or another issuer-approved method.

failures.outcome: No instruction is created and no credentials can be retrieved

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/instructions (with the authentication result)
steps.detail: The agent creates the purchase instruction in VIC. Visa's client sends the consumer's verification result (assuranceData) inside this request, so VIC holds an authenticated Payment Instruction.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/instructions/{instructionId}/credentials
steps.detail: The agent retrieves payment credentials after VIC validates the request against the instruction.

steps.label: TAP checkout with the payment container
steps.detail: The agent signs the checkout with agent-payer-auth and carries the payment data in agenticPaymentContainer.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/instructions/{instructionId}/confirmations
steps.detail: The agent reports the transaction outcome to Visa, which retains the confirmation data for disputes.
